source: Creator-approved mature-love route from the current chat on 2026-08-10, rebuilt after the creator rejected the earlier logistics-led visual deck

concept.title: The Love We Grow Into
concept.human_truth: Mature love does not mean becoming less irritating or less human. It means learning the need beneath each other's small reactions, staying near without crowding, and still choosing the date when the plan falls apart.
concept.emotional_arc: aspirational promise -> familiar small irritation -> requested space -> respectful nearness -> noticing the deeper need -> improvised roadside date -> funny shared-habit coda
concept.format_shell: A continuous roadside date story with a cover flash-forward, one causally linked pre-date diptych, and one explicit two-vignette storybook coda.
concept.public_send_reason: Send this to the person you want to grow into this kind of love with.

visual_setup: HYBRID CINEMATIC EVIDENCE SEQUENCE. One coherent rain-damp evening date world. Slides 1 and 3-6 use the same fixed geography and non-text identifiers: one charcoal compact sedan parked parallel to the service-lane curb with the same silver five-spoke rear wheel, small red rear-light wedge, and rear-right three-quarter orientation; one narrow blue-grey metal chai counter with a small rust-red canopy and exactly two round dark-wood stools; one warm terracotta restaurant doorway with a muted sage awning across the divider; one closed deep-navy umbrella with a curved dark-wood handle leaning against the car; one wardrobe and weather state. None has a sign, word, logo, price, menu, person, or reflection. Slide 2 visibly bridges apartment to car: the same single key with a red fob moves from caught handbag strap to the parked car ignition, and Aachu's mild frustration carries into the route vignette and then slide 3. Slide 7 is an explicit earlier callback outside the apartment, rendered as two unframed chronological storybook vignettes separated by clean ivory paper; its final beat uses a shared amused glance and coordinated closed-door test so it reads as a ritual, never as a door they cannot open. No scooter, motorbike, helmet, menu text, shop text, road text, restaurant lettering, background people, live-looking reflections, footprints, arrows, or decorative labels anywhere. Wardrobe is locked to together-01.jpg: Aachu in white wrap shirt, blue jeans, red shoes, red handbag; Zuv in pale blue shirt, charcoal trousers, black-red shoes. Faces and body proportions also use together-18.jpg and reel-jaldi.jpg. Visual progression across slides 3-6: phone held -> phone fully pocketed; body distance widens -> gaze shifts from route to Aachu -> both occupy the same two chai stools.
identity_prompt_override: CURRENT STORY IDENTITY OVERRIDE — HARD LOCK, overriding any generic dossier or character-bible adjective. Attach only the three original photos, never the generated contact sheet. together-01.jpg controls the full-body proportions, exact two-inch standing height difference, and the sole wardrobe for every vignette. reel-jaldi.jpg controls Aachu's real face, eye and brow shape, oval cheek structure, lips, and long dark hair. together-18.jpg controls Zuv's real face, thick brows, dark hair volume, nose, jaw, and short natural beard. Both have warm medium-brown South Asian skin and normal adult proportions at the same depth: Aachu is 5 feet 6 inches and Zuv is 5 feet 8 inches, exactly two inches apart. Never describe or render Aachu as petite, tiny, fair, fair-medium, or child-scaled; never render Zuv oversized, lanky, chiseled, or dramatically taller. Sole wardrobe for all seven slides and both time vignettes: Aachu wears the plain white wrap shirt, blue jeans, red shoes, and red handbag from together-01.jpg; Zuv wears the plain pale-blue shirt, charcoal trousers, and black-red shoes from together-01.jpg. No shirt lettering or embroidery, grey blazer, dark shirt, tinted glasses, bridal styling, lehenga, sherwani, dupatta, wedding jewelry, or alternate outfit.
